what_a_rebuilt_packet_cannot_be_blocked_.correction_of_record: the rejected cycle 39033797087 published this statement UNQUALIFIED as the whole enforcement envelope. That is false: the accepted population-free label_lineage_gate DOES block a lineage packet whose pooled support rate is strictly below the derived incumbent rate 5/65 even when its scored counter-row count differs from 65. Accepted evidence: results/evaluation/label_lineage_gate/39020603510_sweep.json, packet 38799024807 (n_scored=7 != 65, n_supported=0, rate 0.0): lineage gate FAIL_REGRESSION / gate_blocks_build true, run_bar_gates LABEL half NOT_APPLICABLE / gate_blocks_build false, readings_disagree_on_this_packet true. what_a_rebuilt_packet_cannot_be_blocked_.naive_consumer_disclosure: the accepted lineage entry point's RECORD-LEVEL two-bar verdict on the zero-counter-row packet is PASS_NO_REGRESSION with exit 0, because the record-level verdict aggregates only gate_blocks_build (FAIL_REGRESSION if EITHER bar blocks, else PASS_NO_REGRESSION) while its own label gate is in state NOT_MEASURED. A consumer that reads only the record-level verdict string or the exit code would misread an absence of measurement as a pass. This is the same naive-consumer-trap class the accepted LABEL_LINEAGE_VERDICT.json exists to prevent, and it is disclosed here rather than hidden; it is a property of the ACCEPTED instrument's aggregation and is NOT changed, patched or re-frozen by this preflight.

headline_findings.statement: a packet that issues NO counter label at all is adjudicated with exit 0 by the run_bar_gates entry point (n_scored=0 makes its label regression verdict NOT_APPLICABLE and the absolute status LABEL_UNSOUND, which is REPORTED and never enforced) and with exit 0 / record-level verdict 'PASS_NO_REGRESSION' by the accepted lineage entry point, whose own label gate is in state NOT_MEASURED (neither a pass nor a block; LABEL_LINEAGE_VERDICT.json: NOT_MEASURED certifies NOTHING). NEITHER instrument certifies such a packet as sound; the lineage entry point's record-level PASS_NO_REGRESSION string on it is an aggregation artefact of gate_blocks_build, not a label pass, and is disclosed as a naive-consumer trap rather than hidden. Publishing support-among-issued with the abstention count and the yield is therefore load-bearing for the rebuild decision, not a nicety

success_rule: PREFLIGHT_COMPLETE if (a) legs A, C and E behave exactly as predicted, (b) the entry point runs to completion on all five legs with no uncaught exception, and (c) every frozen input re-hashes to instrument_pins_sha256 afterwards.
